profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record is tagged with the operator name CenturyLink, the legacy brand of the telecommunications company now operating as Lumen Technologies, which formally renamed itself in September 2020. Its coordinates fall in the West Salem area of Salem, Marion County, Oregon, near State Street, but no aggregator, operator, or trade-press source reachable this session named a specific facility at this location: a dedicated area listing for Salem returned a page-view-limit error rather than facility data, a guessed direct listing URL returned a 404, and a statewide Oregon listing gave only aggregate market-level counts without operator or address detail. Rather than assume this is a genuine colocation data center comparable to CenturyLink/Lumen's larger metro facilities, this entry treats it as most likely a legacy telephone central-office or exchange building serving the Salem area, a common category of "data_center"-tagged OpenStreetMap point that reflects historical ILEC (incumbent local exchange carrier) infrastructure rather than a modern, multi-tenant colocation facility; CenturyLink's corporate lineage runs through US West, Qwest, Embarq, and other legacy telecom mergers that built out a large Pacific Northwest exchange network long before the company adopted the Lumen name. No address, square footage, or capacity figure can be honestly asserted for a building of this uncertain type and no located source, so this entry is deliberately left short of confirmed facility-level detail. Oregon was not among the 20 states Lumen divested to Brightspeed in its 2022 sale of legacy CenturyLink local telephone assets to Apollo Global Management, a deal covering states such as Missouri, Georgia, and North Carolina but explicitly leaving Lumen operating directly under the CenturyLink brand in a set of western states that includes Oregon, consistent with this rows retained CenturyLink operator tag. A nearby retail CenturyLink storefront at the same 740 State Street address in West Salem, noted in consumer review listings, suggests this stretch of State Street has long served as a local CenturyLink service point, though that alone does not confirm the specific building type or function of this OSM-mapped facility.
